subject.title: feat(workspace): add tiered bootstrap loading with configurable bootstrapTier

question: Should OpenClaw accept `agents.defaults.bootstrapTier` as a core config surface now, and if so are this PR's unset-default and hook-extra semantics the desired contract?
rationale: The source gap and implementation are bounded, but adding a config/default surface changes prompt context and session behavior in a way automation should not decide.

options.title: Sponsor This Opt-In Contract
options.body: Proceed with this PR shape after public docs are aligned and exact-head checks refresh, preserving no-override defaults while defining explicit minimal, standard, and full tiers.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Bootstrap Selection
options.body: Pause this PR and combine it with the broader deterministic bootstrap/session-selection work so one public selector owns all related behavior.

options.title: Decline A New Config Knob
options.body: Keep the fixed filters and steer users to existing contextInjection, bootstrap budgets, lightweight mode, and future plugin/context APIs instead.
